verdict.rationale: Anthropic's spec strongly documents that every SKILL.md must include a description field stating what the skill does and when to use it, plus frontmatter controlling who/when invokes it, which should let developers predict activation (anthropic-skills-docs-17, -29, -32, -44, -3, -34). However, multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict predictable activation: users with properly formatted YAML/semantic triggers report skills are 'hit or miss', not triggered on expected keywords, or ignored entirely unless explicitly invoked (anthropic-skills-comm-6, -7, -9, -11, -12), undermining the story's promise of predictable, surprise-free behavior. Missing for 10: reliable, reproducible triggering behavior in practice and first-party acknowledgment/fix for inconsistent auto-invocation.
